description.en: The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 取消EIP最大可用带宽值设置

descriptions.zh:
在调用本接口时，请了解以下内容：
- 取消后，EIP的最大可用带宽值和共享带宽一致。
- **CancelCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth**接口不支持并发取消同一个EIP的最大可用带宽值设置。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, take note of the following items:

*   After this operation is performed, the maximum bandwidth of the EIP equals that of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.
*   You cannot repeatedly call the **CancelCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth** operation within a specific time period.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc cancel-common-bandwidth-package-ip-bandwidth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-bp13d0m4e2qv8xxxxxxxx --eip-id eip-2zewysoansu0sxxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
